statements.status_notes: Identity-enabled collections or maps can perform quadratic work when forward object-ID references are resolved in reverse order. The required JsonIdentityInfo application model and attacker-controlled JSON path remain unverified. Upstream fixes the relevant 2.21 line in 2.21.7. The observed bundled Jackson component has base version 2.21.5. Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 ships this code inside vendor-assembled bundles. Changing a standalone library dependency does not replace that bundled implementation; a compatible vendor release or validated bundle remediation and application-specific applicability assessment remain unresolved. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cxp5-3px4-pw24.

The default polymorphic type validator omits Comparable from its unsafe base types. A Comparable-typed property with bare JsonTypeInfo and no custom validator can therefore admit unintended subtypes. Built-in file and jar providers do not themselves perform network I/O on this path; harmful side effects require another provider. The available providers and application binding paths remain unverified. Upstream fixes the relevant 2.21 line in 2.21.6. The observed bundled Jackson component has base version 2.21.5. jackson-databind 2.22.2 is bytecode-shaded inside parquet-hadoop-bundle 1.18.1 (latest on Maven Central). Gradle resolutionStrategy cannot relocate shaded classes; swapping class files without a shade step breaks linkage. Fixing requires an upstream parquet-hadoop-bundle release that embeds jackson-databind 2.22.3 or later.

Neo4j Maven property bumps the standalone jackson-databind artifacts to 2.22.3. The only remaining 2.22.2 copy is shaded and relocated inside parquet-jackson 1.18.1, which has no newer parquet release. parquet-jackson deserializes only its own fixed-schema footer metadata POJOs and does not declare @JsonIdentityInfo on collections or maps whose element types an attacker could influence through Neo4j's Parquet read path, so CVE-2026-91777 is not reachable.

The flagged copy is shaded inside optional backend jars (the Spark/Hadoop OLAP backend or the HBase shaded client) and cannot be upgraded independently; the standalone jackson-databind in lib/ is upgraded separately. These backends are not used by the default JanusGraph configuration (BerkeleyJE storage with Lucene indexing); reachability assessment pending.
